title: Out Toward Phobos

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: Uneasy: drones killing 160 across Sudan, Houthi attacks in Yemen, Riyadh's investment forum cancelled, Gaza food aid cut, floods in eastern Spain, an Australian MP gravely hurt. Against it: Japan launched for Phobos, Brazil ended the six-day week, Mozambique saved a butterfly forest.

style.genre: liquid drum-and-bass — harp, clarinet, sub bass, HR-16

sampleSources: Strudel default library (VCSL harp, GM clarinet, Alesis HR-16)

lines: the bread runs short in Gaza now,
Riyadh cancels its show at dawn.
Rain comes down on Spain's east coast,
Europe sums what Kyiv still needs,
a car as weapon, an MP's blood.
But a rocket's climbing out toward Phobos,
Brazil gave back the seventh day,
keep a mountain no one takes away.
